segments.source: The identifiers below refer to the uploaded snapshots, not to an inferred Git commit. Full archive SHA-256 values are in the companion manifest. Paths identify the main evidence used for each discussion. The machine-readable source register also hashes the individual files, allowing a later audit to distinguish a changed implementation from a changed interpretation.
R01 · spock
A small numeric kernel and its semantic interpretations. Positive scalar confidence disappears under the inspected cosine-based comparison. The selected repository runner passed 350 checks.
Principal source paths: src/kernel/primitiveOps.js; src/kernel/vectorSpace.js; docs/THEORY.md; docs/WHY_IT_WORKS.md.
R02 · HDC-RE

Hybrid proof and query paths combine similarity with direct matches, chains, and rule machinery. The selected suite passed 476 tests and failed thirteen. The failures are retained rather than converted into a general conclusion about the algebra.
Principal source paths: src/reasoning/prove.mjs; src/reasoning/query.mjs.
R03 · VSARepresentations

The main source for alternative carriers, operator counterexamples, elastic allocation, and exact combinatorial growth. The selected unit suite passed 807 of 808 tests; the failed CommonJS entry-point test is a packaging issue. A separate twelve-configuration evaluation is recorded in A03.

Principal source paths: src/​hdc/​strategies/​sparse-​polynomial.mjs; src/​hdc/​strategies/​metric-​affine.mjs; src/​hdc/​strategies/​metric-​affine-​elastic.mjs; src/hdc/strategies/exact.mjs; evals/runFastEval.mjs.
R04 · VSANash

Retrieval-aware sharding and placement. Twenty-three tests passed. Three HRR scenarios were rerun with eleven strategies each. The named AI review is a source for its explicitly attributed diagnostic suggestions, not for a complete development chronology.
Principal source paths: src/sharding/equilibrium.mjs; src/eval/scenarios.mjs; tests/eval/runEval.mjs; antigravity_review.md.
R05 · VSABrains2

Structured episodic and reference-frame experiments. Thirty-three tests passed, and experiments 1, 2, 3, 4, and 6 were rerun. The first-trial consensus aggregation and exact-map query proxy are inspected implementation properties.
Principal source paths: eval/exp1-alignment/run.mjs; eval/exp2-narrative/run.mjs; eval/exp3-rag/run.mjs; eval/exp4-consensus/run.mjs; eval/exp6-literature/run.mjs.
R06 · VSAText

Narrative schemas, text encoding, and structural evaluation. The selected runner passed 268 tests. The role-order collision and trait-count proxy were demonstrated by new probes. The Codex-attributed review documents its own runtime criticism.
Principal source paths: src/vsa/encoder.mjs; src/evaluate/metrics.mjs; codex_review.md; README.md.
R07 · VSAVM

An executable VM and macro-oriented continuation experiment. The original selected suite passed 305 of 307 tests; a separate declaration-order repair passed all 307. The standard evaluation reported eleven passing categories. These are different protocols.
Principal source paths: src/​training/​outer-​loop/​macro-​unit-​model.mjs; evals/run.mjs; README.md.
R08 · SomaVM

Integer predictive learning and a supplied checkpoint. Seven tests passed. The checkpoint was evaluated with its own configuration on twenty included records, producing zero exact matches. Memory-enabled variants were not thereby evaluated.
Principal source paths: README.md; src/cli/eval.mjs; Eval/​data/​core_​preK_​eval_​large.jsonl; Eval/​checkpoints/​core_​preK_​long_​max100.json; Eval/​checkpoints/​core_​preK_​long_​max100.bin.
R09 · BSP

Explicit grouping and compression operations. Forty-six tests passed. Six abstract-primitives systems completed before the bounded sweep timed out. A new untrained-engine probe demonstrates the vacuous negation score. Compression-cost claims remain historical reports.

Principal source paths: src/core/CompressionMachine.mjs; evals/​abstract_​primitives/​06_​negation/​scorer.mjs; evals/​abstract_​primitives/​06_​negation/​generator.mjs; experiments/COMPRESSION_INSIGHTS.md; experiments/​SESSION_​2026-​01-​16_​FINAL_​SUMMARY.md.
R10 · UBHNL

Typed parsing, compilation scaffolding, and canonical structures. The default development runner contains no implemented development tests. The separate typed-AST checks passed. Broader solver ambitions in the design documents remain distinct from executed capabilities.
Principal source paths: src/index.mjs; src/kernel/store.mjs; src/dsl/ast.mjs; src/compiler/ubh-compiler.mjs; src/devtests/run.mjs; src/devtests/typed-ast-tests.mjs.
R11 · CNL

An executable constrained language, transactional compilation, provenance-related structures, and bounded planning. Eighty-five tests and eleven smoke suites passed. This does not establish unrestricted natural-language translation.
Principal source paths: src/session/cnl-session.mjs; src/provenance/justifications.mjs; evals/runSmoke.mjs; README.md.
R12 · HoloProof

Formal proposal, world management, retrieval, and solver orchestration. Seventy-three tests passed. The live smoke matrix produced twelve dependency errors. The independent finite-Boolean probe tests the real orchestration but is not a third-party SMT solver replication.
Principal source paths: src/sdk/reasoning/queryExecutor.mjs; src/​sdk/​reasoning/​expansionPolicy.mjs; src/sdk/solver/smtEmitter.mjs; eval/runEval.mjs; README.md.
R13 · autoResearchLib

A bounded frontier of alternative theories and question policies. Eighteen of nineteen tests passed; the failure concerns expected sibling-project discovery. All seven experiment runners completed. Their regenerated tables and trace artifacts support the analysis of recovery and harmful contraction.

Principal source paths: README.md; scripts/run-experiments.mjs; experiments/experiment1/run.mjs; experiments/experiment4/run.mjs; experiments/experiment5/run.mjs; experiments/experiment6/run.mjs; experiments/experiment7/run.mjs.
R14 · vsaAbduction / Eos Gate

The semantic invariant experiment was regenerated. Source and controls support a restricted additive-law claim, not open-ended scientific induction. The assistance disclosure supports only the authorship and intervention statements it explicitly records. The dual-readout study is a new audit experiment.
Principal source paths: src/world.js; src/abductor.js; scripts/run_experiment.js; test/verify_results.js; results/summary.json; docs/human_review_and_agent_use.md.
R15 · vsaLLM / VSA-PathMoE
